title: Sample audit 4: TradingView built-in Supertrend Strategy (ATR 10, factor 3) on BTC daily
hypothesis: The TradingView built-in 'Supertrend Strategy' with its default settings (ATR period 10, factor 3), applied to BTC-USD daily bars, beats buy-and-hold BTC after costs.
rubric: Holdout Labs Fragility Rubric v1.1 (docs/RUBRIC-v1.1.md, SHA-256 2311b126336bab9f426a84f9c9cd9cb937e346b403a62f60e3c96ed8b5868e46), objective (a) beat the benchmark. The grade is reported whatever it is.

rule.indicator: Pine ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod): src = hl2; ATR = Wilder RMA of true range (seeded with the simple mean of the first atrPeriod bars); bands carried forward as in Pine; direction -1 (up) / +1 (down). Implementation: samples/strategies.py (supertrend_direction).
rule.positions: Decided at the UTC daily close t and held from close t to close t+1. long_short (the TradingView built-in strategy): +1 in an uptrend, -1 in a downtrend. long_flat: +1 in an uptrend, 0 otherwise. Before the first defined direction the position is 0.
rule.known_differences_from_tradingview: TradingView fills strategy orders at the next bar's open; we use close-to-close returns. TradingView starts flat until the first direction change; we take the position implied by the current direction from the first bar of the audit period. Short-side funding or borrow costs are not modelled.

data.source: Coinbase Exchange public market-data API, /products/BTC-USD/candles, granularity 86400 (UTC daily OHLC), fetched by samples/data/fetch.py into samples/data/raw/btc_ohlc_daily.csv after this document is sealed; the file's SHA-256 is recorded in samples/data/MANIFEST.json and printed in the report.
data.history_start: 2015-07-20 (first Coinbase daily candle; used for indicator warm-up)

costs: 10 bps per unit of turnover, one way (a long-to-short flip is 2 units); the rubric's cost curve runs 0-50 bps.
prior_exposure: The auditors have previously seen buy-and-hold BTC and 50-day moving-average trend results on Coinbase BTC-USD daily closes (sample audit 3, 2016-2026). No Supertrend result on BTC has been computed before this preregistration was sealed. The Supertrend code was tested only on synthetic data.
commitments: No change to the rule, grid, chosen variant, costs, dates or holdout after sealing. Any deviation will be listed in the report as a deviation.
